race.description: Paxston Street Storage Class One Hcp
race.comment: Looks a good race for MAYSOONFLY (10). Resumed over 1000m and stalked the speed before boxing on well to finish runner-up. Fitter and the extra trip looks a plus now. Apprentice rider replaced by Holder and looks hard to run down. DAMELLI (6) doesn't win very often but ran a strong race last time out over 1200m at Murray Bridge, finishing second and beaten 2 lengths. Close to a win and looks a leading hope this time. SILVALOA (2) resumed three weeks ago over 1000m at Murray Bridge and was only beaten 1.5 lengths into seventh. Was run off legs but kept coming. Much improved and will be tough to hold out over the extra ground. RICH BRITT (9) made some progress last start to finish seventh over 1000m at Murray Bridge, beaten 4.5 lengths. Extra trip looks a plus and can settle closer this time. BIG RITA JUNE (4) ran well fresh and is another who will be improved second-up.
